policy: Whole-role functional proposals. Do not attribute a single philosophy to an entire country. Unreviewed etymologies are not asserted.
sources: WorldOS naming/terms.json (CLDR language selection and prior proposals)
review: Native-speaker review pending; proposals are not official standard terminology.

thread_example.name: filTravail
thread_example.meaning: An independently scheduled execution sequence; current kernel schedules cooperatively.

functional_review.compound_status: Modern function-based project proposals; native-speaker review pending.

naming_scope: First-party identifiers and paths; language keywords, external APIs, dependency archives, legal clauses, copyright and literal character values retain their specified identities.
unverified_terms: native-pending.tsv; terms absent from language dictionaries are not certified translations.

terminology_proposals.scope: Original code roles composed using this language glossary. Modern proposals, not historically attested compounds. No related-language fallback or opaque collision suffix.
terminology_proposals.naming_principles: French head-first noun groups and verb-first actions; use established computing roots rather than shortest dictionary senses.

verified_lexeme_history.history: Attested in the thirteenth century, from Late Latin nucalis (of the size of a nut).
verified_lexeme_history.project_use: The central-core metaphor motivates the OS kernel name; the project name is a modern computing compound.

java_prose.scope: Explicit whole-sentence Java translations; other prose remains pending.
